pageTitle: Klacks for Hospitals | 24/7 Schedules & Rest Periods

hero.titleHtml: Schedules that work around the clock.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules wards and shifts with no gaps — with rest periods respected, the right qualifications, and full data sovereignty. On-premise, so patient data never leaves your building.
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.

items.title: 24/7 with no gaps
items.text: Day, night, weekend, public holiday: every ward has to be staffed without gaps — even with last-minute absences.

items.title: Rest periods & the law
items.text: Complying with labor law, rest periods, and maximum limits is mandatory — and nearly impossible to track by hand.

items.title: Hospital-grade data protection
items.text: Staff and patient data must not leave the building. A mandatory cloud is often unacceptable.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for clinics
solutions.subtitle: From gap-free night shifts to the float pool — it all works together.

items.title: Gap-free 24/7 coverage
items.text: Day, late, and night shifts across every ward — Klacks flags every gap instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: Rest periods checked automatically
items.text: Labor law, rest periods, and maximum limits are monitored in real time — violations never happen in the first place.

items.title: Qualifications & wards
items.text: Every shift is assigned only to appropriately qualified staff — by ward, department, and role.

items.title: On-premise: data stays in-house
items.text: Klacks runs on your infrastructure. Staff and patient data never leave the clinic — not even for the AI.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Fill next week's night shifts for internal medicine” is enough — Klacksy factors in qualification and rest periods.

items.title: Float pool & absences
items.text: If someone drops out, Klacks immediately shows available, qualified float staff — without turning the whole schedule upside down.

example.title: Multiple wards, day and night shifts, one float pool
example.text: Each ward has its own staffing rules and qualification requirements. Klacks schedules them all together, checks rest periods automatically, and draws on the float pool when someone is absent — the ward manager can see at any time where things are getting tight.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your clinic
cta.text: In a personal demo, we'll show you how Klacks handles wards, rest periods, and float staff for your facility.
